settings.external_editor.label: External editor command
settings.external_editor.description: Command to edit config files, e.g. 'ghostty -e nvim' (a terminal + editor). Leave empty to open the file's folder in your file manager instead.
settings.icon_color.label: Icon color
settings.icon_color.description: Color of the icon in the bar widget.
settings.show_in_control_center.label: Show in control center
settings.show_in_control_center.descript: Enable the control center shortcut tile (place it from Settings → Control Center shortcuts).
